quotes.text: I implemented CSS geometry properties for SVG2 in resvg with Claude. I know it works and I've read the diff. But I'm afraid to send a PR because it might offend an artisanal handcrafted free-range software enthusiast. I guess any other AI enjoyer who needs this feature will just burn a few tokens and do it themselves to keep the luddites from smashing the factories.
quotes.author: jerkstate
quotes.source: Hacker News — QGIS bans AI assisted contributions
quotes.extraction_note: Peak HN drama distilled: 'artisanal handcrafted free-range software enthusiast' is an all-timer insult, and the underlying point about balkanized forks is real.
